settings.title: Hotels, residences and spaces
settings.text: Sofas, armchairs, poufs, trunks and tables in full-grain leather, made for the room they will stand in. The lobby of the Miramare Palace in Sanremo began as one such conversation.

settings.title: Collaborations
settings.text: Editions made with houses from other fields, built the way they think and made the way we make everything else. For Trax NYC, a jeweller in New York, it was a line of cases for pieces of real value.

settings.title: Corporate and private gifts
settings.text: Pieces for clients, teams and events, with a name or a logo stamped in gold, silver or blind, and packed in boxes made in Italy.

settings.title: Interior designers and architects
settings.text: For designers and architects furnishing a home, a hotel or an office: pieces made to your drawings and dimensions.

settings.title: Work with us
settings.intro: Beyond the collection, we make pieces with and for others: shops that would like to carry the house, and hotels and homes that need pieces made to measure. Every piece is made by hand in our ateliers around Milan.
settings.form_text: Tell us who you are and what you have in mind. We read every message and reply personally.
settings.kinds: Hotels and spaces, Interior design, Collaboration, Corporate gifts, Something else
settings.thanks: Thank you. We have your message and will reply personally.
